learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge about marine pollution and types of pollution based on their sources.
Learn how to select discharge locations and environmental properties.
Gain awareness about pollution in our seas (Black Sea, Marmara Sea, Aegean and Mediterranean) and national and international laws and regulations regarding marine pollution (MARPOL 73/78).

syllabus_topics: Types of Pollution from Ship Sources
Types of Pollution from Land Sources
Types of Pollution from Emission Sources
Pollution by Oil and Oil Derivatives
Effects of Marine Discharge during Ship Operation
Effects of Marine Discharge in Case of Ship Accident
Investigation of Discharge Location and Environmental Characteristics
Pollution in Our Seas (Black Sea, Marmara Sea, Aegean and Mediterranean)
National and International Laws and Regulations Related to Marine Pollution (MARPOL73/78)
